Million Manhoef is a Dutch professional footballer of Dutch-Surinamese descent, known for his skills as a winger. Born on January 3, 2002, in the Netherlands, he has developed a reputation for his pace, dribbling ability, and versatility on the field. Manhoef emerged from the youth academy of Vitesse, a prominent football club in the Netherlands that competes in the Eredivisie.

He made his professional debut for Vitesse in early 2021. Since then, he has been seen as a promising young talent in Dutch football, drawing attention for his performances in domestic competitions. Despite his youth, Manhoef's development has been noteworthy, contributing to both offensive plays and defensive responsibilities on the wing.

Growing up, Million Manhoef was part of a sports-oriented family, and his football journey has been closely watched by scouts and football enthusiasts. As of the last update, his career was still in the early stages, but he was considered one of the prospects to watch in Dutch football.

Additionally, Manhoef's development could lead to interest from bigger clubs both within the Netherlands and abroad, as is common with talented young players in the Eredivisie. His progress and potential make him a player to watch in the coming years as he continues to mature and grow in his professional career.
